name: After Effects SMF Test Artifact Superset
source: After Effects SMF Test Coverage matrix
purpose: Deadline Cloud After Effects submitter E2E: submit from mac workstation to Windows SMF workers.
ae_version_notes: AE 2024 (v24) intentionally not produced (not installed; skipped per request). AE 2025 = v25.6.6, AE 2026 = v26.3.

conventions.determinism: No random or time-of-day values; frame-reproducible for output diffing.
conventions.burned_in_text: Every comp burns in: test id + name, asset version, AE version, 'mac -> Windows SMF'.

output_module_note: An output module's format can only be set by applying one of AE's built-in templates: getSettings()'s Format key is read-only, so setSettings({Format: ...}) fails. AE ships no JPEG Sequence, PNG Sequence or MP3 template, so the formats the coverage matrix names for T07 / T08 / T19-emit are unreachable from script. The builder uses the nearest available built-ins instead -- TIFF Sequence with Alpha for image sequences (lossless and per-frame, better for output diffing than JPEG) and AIFF 48kHz for audio-only -- and hard-fails if the applied template does not yield the intended format, rather than silently falling back to H.264 as it did before 2026-10-01. Setting a [#####] output path on a sequence template preserves the sequence numbering.

ttc.expected: not used: fails on the Windows fleet (RENDER_FINDINGS #3)
